types.name: Checkpoint
docs: u128 split into halves so the layout is identical on the host and on SBF.

types.name: Checkpoints
docs: Ring of accumulator snapshots at hour boundaries where boosts expired (DESIGN.md §5).
17 KB, larger than a CPI-created account may be, so it is a keypair account created in the
initialize transaction; its address is bound in `Config`.

types.name: Config
docs: Global settings. Seeds: ["config"]. Admin is the Squads vault (DESIGN.md §9).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer; Pubkey::default() when none.

fields.name: checkpoints
docs: Address of the `Checkpoints` keypair account.

fields.name: uri_base
docs: Metadata URI prefix; the asset address is appended.

types.name: Harbor
docs: One per player. Seeds: ["harbor", owner].

fields.name: docked
docs: Subs in dock slots, including any away on an expedition.

fields.name: boost_sub
docs: Sub whose expedition produced the active boost; default when none.

fields.name: expedition_sub
docs: Sub currently on an expedition; default when none.

fields.name: depth
docs: Depth of docked subs that are not away. Excludes the boost.

types.name: Params
docs: Tunable economics (config/defaults.json). Every change is bounds-checked by `validate`.

types.name: PendingMint
docs: A paid mint awaiting its randomness. Seeds: ["pending", mint_index].

fields.name: randomness
docs: ORAO request account.

types.name: Pool
docs: Reward accounting and fleet counters. Seeds: ["pool"].

fields.name: minted_count
docs: Next mint index (also counts merge outputs). Asset PDAs are ["asset", index].

fields.name: active_harbors
docs: Harbors with depth > 0.

fields.name: total_depth
docs: Sum of docked harbor depths plus boosts that have not reached their end boundary.

fields.name: stream_remaining
docs: Lamports deposited but not yet credited to the accumulator.

fields.name: total_credited
docs: Lamports reserved for harbors through the accumulator.

types.name: Sub
docs: Stats for one sub. Seeds: ["sub", asset].

fields.name: base_depth
docs: Tier depth at mint time (later config changes do not affect existing subs).

fields.name: depth
docs: base_depth with reinforcement; what the sub contributes while docked.

fields.name: harbor
docs: Harbor while docked, away or returning; default when idle.

fields.name: randomness
docs: ORAO request account for the return roll.

fields.name: fallback
docs: True when randomness was never revealed and the fallback (lowest tier) applied.

types.name: Vault
docs: Holds pool lamports only. Seeds: ["vault"]. Only `claim` moves lamports out.
